title: Position Matters More Than Channel: Talking a Language Model Out of a Correct Answer
abstract: arXiv:2610.34809v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language models now answer questions alongside other claims: a note in the system prompt, a message from another agent, their own earlier answer. We ask what it takes to talk a model out of an answer it gets right on its own, and separate three factors that earlier studies vary together: where the advice sits in the prompt, who is said to have written it, and what the model has already written. On Qwen3.5-27B and four-option MMLU-Pro items, with the rest of the advice held fixed in each comparison, we find three things. First, position matters far more than the API channel, in opposite directions for a bare claim and an argument: a bare "the answer is X" does most harm just before the model answers, while the same claim with a false rationale does most harm before the question, where it raises error on items the model otherwise almost never misses from 1% to 67%; moving the claim between the system message and the user message at the sam

translated_title: 位置比通道更重要：说服语言模型放弃正确答案
translated_abstract: 语言模型如今在回答问题时会伴随其他声明出现：系统提示中的备注、来自其他智能体的消息，或其自身先前的回答。我们研究需要什么才能让模型放弃它原本能答对的答案，并将以往研究中常常混在一起的三个因素分离开来：建议在提示中所处的位置、据说撰写该建议的人是谁，以及模型已经写下的内容。在 Qwen3.5-27B 和四选项 MMLU-Pro 题目上，在每次比较中固定其余建议的情况下，我们发现了三点。首先，位置远比 API 通道更重要，且对裸声明和论证的影响方向相反：一个简单的“答案是 X”在模型即将作答之前危害最大，而带有虚假理由的同一声明则在问题提出之前危害最大，此时它能把模型原本几乎从不答错的题目错误率从 1% 提升到 67%；在系统消息和用户消息之间移动该声明……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究发现建议在提示中的位置比 API 通道更能左右语言模型是否放弃正确答案——裸声明在模型作答前危害最大，而带虚假理由的论证在提问前危害最大，可将模型原本几乎不会答错的题目错误率从 1% 提升至 67%。
en_tdlr: Position of advice in the prompt matters far more than the API channel: a bare claim does most harm right before the model answers, while the same claim with a false rationale does most harm before the question, raising error rates on items the model almost never misses from 1% to 67%.
